description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kalalpitiya, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510600
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extent of land, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land registration, property ownership, and title settlement - all core elements of the Land Gazettes category.
